findings.justification: This table shows operating income contribution by segment for the year ended December 31, 2025. Bottling Investments contributed only 3.1% to total operating income, which is the lowest positive contribution among all operating segments (EMEA 31.2%, Latin America 27.2%, North America 36.8%, Asia Pacific 14.9%). This demonstrates that Bottling Investments is the weakest contributor to overall profitability among the operating segments in 2025.

findings.key_quote: Year Ended December 31, 2025 2024 Consolidated 28.7 % 21.2 % EMEA 39.7 41.4 Latin America 59.1 58.6 North America 25.9 24.1 Asia Pacific 38.3 42.1 Bottling Investments 7.4 8.0
findings.justification: This table shows operating margin by segment for the year ended December 31, 2025. Bottling Investments had an operating margin of 7.4%, which is significantly lower than all other operating segments (EMEA 39.7%, Latin America 59.1%, North America 25.9%, Asia Pacific 38.3%) and well below the consolidated margin of 28.7%. This demonstrates that Bottling Investments is a drag on overall profitability in 2025.

findings.key_quote: Our consolidated bottling operations derive the majority of their revenues from the manufacture and sale of finished beverages. Generally, finished product operations generate higher net operating revenues but lower gross profit margins than concentrate operations.
findings.justification: This passage explains the structural nature of the Bottling Investments segment (finished product operations have lower gross profit margins than concentrate operations), which provides context for why the segment might have lower profitability. However, it does not provide actual 2025 results showing that the segment is a drag on overall profitability.

findings.key_quote: Bottling Investments' operating income for the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024 was $426 million and $496 million, respectively. The decrease in operating income was primarily driven by the impact of refranchising our bottling operations in the Philippines, Bangladesh and certain territories in India, higher commodity costs and an unfavorable foreign currency exchange rate impact of 2%
findings.justification: This provides the absolute operating income figures for Bottling Investments ($426 million in 2025) and explains the year-over-year decrease. While it shows the segment's profitability level, it does not directly compare this to other segments or demonstrate whether it is a drag on overall profitability relative to the rest of the company.

findings.key_quote: If our bottling partners' financial condition deteriorates, our business and financial results could be affected.
findings.justification: This is a risk factor discussing potential future impacts if bottling partners' financial condition deteriorates. It does not provide actual 2025 results showing whether the Bottling Investments segment was a drag on profitability.

findings.key_quote: These investments are intended to result in increases in unit case volume, net operating revenues and profits at the bottler level, which in turn generate increased sales for our Company's concentrate operations.
findings.justification: This describes the strategic intent and purpose of bottling investments, not the actual 2025 results showing whether the Bottling Investments segment was a drag on overall profitability.
